one_liner: Senior Executive Service leader running DHS S&T's research and development portfolio for cyber defense, critical infrastructure protection, and response and resilience technologies.
fit_summary: This SES role requires executive leadership plus mastery of science and technology management and complex cyber or infrastructure programs. Daniel's FEMA exercise and emergency planning work touches the resilience mission, but his resume shows no executive leadership, budgets or R&D portfolios, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (hiring paths include public and SES), so no federal status is needed, but veterans' preference does not apply.
Your two-page resume must show all five Executive Core Qualifications and both Technical Qualifications; separate narratives are not accepted.
Requires a Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance, which means a TS/SCI background investigation if selected.
No education requirement, but the selectee must be certified by OPM's SES Qualifications Review Board and serve a one-year probationary period.
strategy: Skip this one: his FEMA exercise and emergency planning work touches the resilience mission, but his resume shows no executive leadership, budgets or R&D portfolios.
GS-9 to GS-12 DHS, FEMA or CISA resilience and preparedness roles fit his resume.
resume_bullets: Facilitated full-scale and tabletop exercises for federal, state and private-sector clients (2022–2024).
Brought emergency management best practices into a large travel company's emergency forms (Feb – Aug 2024).
interview_questions: Describe a time you led an organization through change and held people accountable for results.
How have you managed resources to cut waste or improve efficiency in a program?
How would you prioritize R&D investments across cyber, infrastructure, and resilience portfolios?
Give an example of coordinating with multiple agencies and the private sector to close a capability gap.
watch_outs: SES level: the panel and QRB expect years of senior executive accomplishments, and junior or mid-level consulting experience will likely be rated not qualified.
Requires SCI clearance eligibility, so expect a lengthy TS/SCI investigation.
The role is heavily cyber and science and technology focused, which is outside your known emergency-management and policy strengths.
